brief_summary: This study evaluates the efficacy and safety and population PK of HMS5552 add-on to Metformin in adult type 2 diabetic subjects. There will be 2 groups in the first 24 weeks, one group will receive HMS5552 plus Metformin, while the other group will receive placebo plus Metformin; after 24 weeks, all subjects will receive HMS5552 plus Metformin for 28 weeks.
brief_title: Long-term Efficacy and Safety of HMS5552 add-on to Metformin in T2DM Subjects
official_title: A 24-week Multi-center, Randomized, Double-blind, Placebo-controlled, Phase III Study to Evaluate the Efficacy and Safety of HMS5552 add-on to Metformin With Additional 28-week Open-label Treatment to Evaluate the Safety in T2DM Subjects
